title: Qualitative Research — Interviews, Focus Groups and Thematic Analysis

hook.en: A trial can tell you how much pain fell. It cannot tell you why a mother stopped doing her child's exercises, or what it feels like to learn to walk again. Those answers live in words, and qualitative research knows how to listen to them.
hook.ur: Trial bata sakta hai dard kitna kam hua. Yeh nahi bata sakta ke maan ne bache ki exercises kyun chhor di, ya dobara chalna seekhna kaisa lagta hai. Yeh jawab alfaaz mein hain, aur qualitative research unhein sunna jaanti hai.

goal.en: By the end, you'll know what qualitative research can answer, choose between interviews and focus groups, follow the steps of thematic analysis, and judge rigour using trustworthiness criteria instead of p-values.
goal.ur: End tak aap jaanenge ke qualitative research kya jawab de sakti hai, interviews aur focus groups mein se chunenge, thematic analysis ke qadam follow karenge, aur p-values ke bajaye bharosemandi ke criteria se rigour parkhenge.

text.en: **Qualitative research** studies meanings, experiences and reasons through words, observation and stories rather than numbers. It answers "how", "why" and "what is it like". Common methods are **semi-structured interviews** (one person, an open guide of questions), **focus groups** (6 to 8 people discussing together) and observation. Analysis is usually **thematic**: reading, coding and grouping the data into themes. The goal is depth and understanding, not statistical generalisation.
text.ur: **Qualitative research** maani, tajurbe aur wajuhaat ko alfaaz, mushahide aur kahaniyon se parhti hai, numbers se nahi. Yeh "kaise", "kyun" aur "kaisa lagta hai" ka jawab deti hai. Aam tareeqe hain **semi-structured interviews** (ek shakhs, sawalon ki khuli rehnumai), **focus groups** (6 se 8 log milkar baat karein) aur mushahida. Tajziya aam taur par **thematic** hota hai: data parhna, code karna aur themes mein jama karna. Maqsad gehraai aur samajh hai, shumariyati generalisation nahi.

text.en: Think of **a geologist and a miner**. A quantitative study measures how much gold is in the hill. A qualitative study goes underground to find out how the veins run and why the gold is there. One gives amounts, the other gives understanding. Good research often needs both.
text.ur: **Mahir-e-arziyat aur kaan-kun** sochein. Quantitative study naapti hai pahar mein kitna sona hai. Qualitative study neeche jaa kar dekhti hai ke rag kaise chalti hain aur sona kyun hai. Ek miqdar deti hai, doosri samajh. Achhi research ko aksar dono chahiye.

title.ur: Interviews aur focus groups ka muqabla

rows.en: Private, deep, good for sensitive topics such as incontinence or pain with intimacy
rows.ur: Nijji, gehra, hassas mauzu jaise rishaw ya jinsi dard ke liye achha

rows.en: Takes time; one voice at a time
rows.ur: Waqt leta hai; ek waqt mein ek awaaz

rows.en: Group discussion sparks ideas and shows shared norms
rows.ur: Group baat cheet khayalat jagati hai aur mushtarak riwayat dikhati hai

rows.en: Dominant voices may silence others, and sensitive topics may be avoided
rows.ur: Hawi awazein doosron ko chup kara sakti hain, hassas mauzu chhoote ja sakte hain

rows.en: Shows what people do, not only what they say
rows.ur: Dikhata hai log kya karte hain, sirf yeh nahi ke kya kehte hain

rows.en: The observer's presence can change behaviour
rows.ur: Mushahida karne wale ki maujoodgi rawaiyya badal sakti hai

steps.title: Get to know the data
steps.detail: Transcribe the interviews and read them several times, noting first impressions. || Data se waqif hon

steps.title: Code
steps.detail: Label chunks of text with short codes, such as "afraid of re-injury" or "no time for exercises". || Code karein

steps.title: Build themes
steps.detail: Group related codes into larger patterns that tell a story, for example "fear and uncertainty" or "family and responsibilities". || Themes banayein

steps.title: Review and define
steps.detail: Check each theme against the data, merge or split, and name it clearly. || Jaiza lein aur tareef karein

steps.title: Write with quotes
steps.detail: Illustrate each theme with the participants' own words, and report how themes fit together. || Iqtebasat ke saath likhein

question.en: A therapist wants to understand why women in her area stop attending postnatal pelvic floor classes. Which design fits best?
question.ur: Ek therapist samajhna chahti hai ke uske ilaqe ki khawateen hamal ke baad pelvic floor classes kyun chhor deti hain. Kaun sa design behtar hai?

text.en: A count of how many dropped out
Qualitative interviews with women who dropped out
text.ur: Un khawateen se qualitative interviews jinhon ne classes chhor di

feedback.en: Yes — a "why" question about experience suits interviews.
feedback.ur: Haan — tajurbe ke "kyun" sawal ke liye interviews munasib hain.

text.en: A trial of the class versus no class
text.ur: Class aur bina class ka trial

feedback.en: A trial tests effect, not reasons for dropping out.
feedback.ur: Trial asar jaanchta hai, chhorne ki wajuhaat nahi.

question.en: Why might a focus group be a poor choice for a study about leakage of urine?
question.ur: Peshab ke rishaw ke study ke liye focus group kyun kamzor intikhab ho sakta hai?

text.en: Participants may feel too embarrassed to speak in a group, so private interviews may give more honest answers
text.ur: Shirkat karne wale group mein bolne mein sharmindagi mehsoos kar sakte hain, isliye nijji interviews zyada imaandar jawab de sakte hain

feedback.en: Yes — sensitive topics often need privacy.
feedback.ur: Haan — hassas mauzu aksar nijiyat chahte hain.

text.ur: Groups hamesha bohat bade hote hain

feedback.en: Size is not the main concern here.

text.en: Focus groups cannot be used in qualitative research
text.ur: Focus groups qualitative research mein istemal nahi ho sakte

question.en: How is the rigour of a qualitative study judged?
question.ur: Qualitative study ka rigour kaise parkha jata hai?

text.en: By whether the sample was as large as a trial
text.ur: Is se ke sample trial jitna bara tha

feedback.en: Qualitative samples are small and purposeful.
feedback.ur: Qualitative samples chhote aur maqsad se chune jate hain.

text.en: By the p-value of the themes

feedback.en: Qualitative research does not use p-values.
feedback.ur: Qualitative research p-values istemal nahi karti.

text.en: By trustworthiness: credibility, transferability, dependability and confirmability, shown by clear methods, participant checking and an audit trail
text.ur: Bharosemandi se: credibility, transferability, dependability aur confirmability, saaf methods, shirkat karne walon ki jaanch aur audit trail se zahir

feedback.en: Yes — these criteria replace p-values and sample-size rules.
feedback.ur: Haan — yeh criteria p-values aur sample-size qaidon ki jagah lete hain.

text.en: **Judging qualitative research by quantitative rules.** Asking "how many participants?" or "is it generalisable?" misses the point. Instead, ask whether participants were chosen to give a range of views, whether the researcher's own influence (reflexivity) was discussed, whether coding was checked by a second person and whether quotes support the themes. Also, avoid "counting themes" as if they were numbers.
text.ur: **Qualitative research ko quantitative qaidon se parkhna.** "Kitne shirkat karne wale?" ya "kya generalisable hai?" poochhna asal baat chhor deta hai. Ulta poochhein ke kya shirkat karne walon ko mukhtalif raaye dene ke liye chuna gaya, kya muhaqqiq ke apne asar (reflexivity) par baat hui, kya coding ko doosre shakhs ne jaancha aur kya iqtebasat themes ki himayat karte hain. Themes ko numbers ki tarah ginne se bhi bachein.

text.en: **Listen like a researcher in everyday care.** Ask open questions such as "What worries you most about going back to work?" and reflect back what you hear. The skills of qualitative interviewing, open questions, silence and curiosity, make you a better clinician even if you never write a paper.
text.ur: **Roz-marra care mein muhaqqiq ki tarah sunein.** Khule sawal poochhein jaise "Kaam par wapas jane ke baare mein sab se zyada kya fikr hai?" aur jo suna woh dohrayein. Qualitative interviewing ki maharatein, khule sawal, khamoshi aur tajassus, aap ko behtar clinician banati hain chahe aap kabhi paper na likhein.

question.en: How many participants does a qualitative study need?
question.ur: Qualitative study ko kitne shirkat karne wale chahiye?

answer.en: There is no fixed number. Researchers often continue until new interviews bring no new ideas, called thematic saturation, which for a focused topic may be 10 to 20 interviews. What matters more is that participants vary in ways relevant to the question, such as age, gender, severity and setting, and that you report how you decided.
answer.ur: Koi mustaqil number nahi. Muhaqqiq aksar tab tak jari rakhte hain jab tak naye interviews naye khayalat na laayen, jise thematic saturation kehte hain, jo ek markooz mauzu ke liye 10 se 20 interviews ho sakte hain. Zyada ahem yeh hai ke shirkat karne wale sawal se mutaliq pehluon mein mukhtalif hon, jaise umar, jins, shiddat aur jagah, aur aap report karein ke faisla kaise kiya.

beats.patient: A physiotherapist wants to know why stroke survivors in her town stop home exercises after discharge. She interviews eight patients and caregivers and codes the transcripts.
beats.assessment: Early codes include "no one to help", "fear of falling", "exercises feel pointless" and "cost of transport to clinic".
beats.treatment: These group into themes: "isolation and lack of support", "fear and loss of confidence" and "practical barriers", and she supports each with quotes.
beats.reassess: Her service adds a phone call at two weeks, a caregiver session and a simpler exercise card; the next group follows the programme longer.

text.en: **Protect people who share their stories.** Get informed consent, promise confidentiality and keep your promise, remove identifying details from quotes, and have a plan if a participant becomes upset or reveals risk of harm. Get ethics approval before interviewing patients, and do not interview your own current patients about your own care, as they may feel unable to be frank.
text.ur: **Apni kahani batane walon ko mehfooz rakhein.** Batayi gayi razamandi lein, raazdari ka waada karein aur nibhayein, iqtebasat se pehchan karwane wali tafseelat hata dein, aur plan rakhein agar shirkat karne wala pareshan ho ya khatre ka zikr kare. Mareezon se interview se pehle ethics ki manzoori lein, aur apne mojooda mareezon se apni hi care ke baare mein interview na karein, kyunke woh saaf baat karne mein jhijak sakte hain.

text.en: Braun and Clarke's widely cited paper describes a six-phase approach to thematic analysis: familiarising with the data, generating initial codes, searching for themes, reviewing themes, defining and naming themes, and producing the report. The COREQ checklist lists 32 items for reporting interviews and focus groups, covering the research team, study design and analysis, to help readers judge how trustworthy a qualitative study is.
text.ur: Braun aur Clarke ka bohat hawale diya jane wala paper thematic analysis ka chhe marhale ka tareeqa bayan karta hai: data se waqifiyat, shuruaati codes banana, themes dhoondhna, themes ka jaiza, themes ki tareef aur naam, aur report banana. COREQ checklist interviews aur focus groups ki report ke liye 32 items batata hai, jo research team, study design aur tajziye ko cover karte hain, taake parhne wale jaanch sakein ke qualitative study kitni bharosemand hai.

text.en: **Listen, Code, Theme, Trust.** Listen to the data, code it, build themes, and show trustworthiness.
text.ur: **Suno, Code, Theme, Bharosa.** Data suno, code karo, themes banao, aur bharosemandi dikhao.

summary.en: Qualitative research explores experiences and reasons using interviews, focus groups and thematic analysis.
summary.ur: Qualitative research interviews, focus groups aur thematic analysis se tajurbe aur wajuhaat dhoondti hai.

summary.en: Choose private interviews for sensitive topics and groups for shared views.
summary.ur: Hassas mauzu ke liye nijji interviews aur mushtarak raaye ke liye groups chunein.

summary.en: Judge rigour by trustworthiness, not p-values, and protect participants.
summary.ur: Rigour ko bharosemandi se parkhein, p-values se nahi, aur shirkat karne walon ko mehfooz rakhein.
